fields.description: Como Residences is Nakheel’s high-rise apartment development on Palm Jumeirah, with two- to seven-bedroom homes, duplex layouts and a rooftop leisure programme. Private lift lobbies and generous terraces shape its low-density residential design.

overview: The tower’s curving terraces and water-themed shared spaces are central to its design. Large apartments and duplex layouts use private lift lobbies, substantial outdoor space and separate service areas, with configurations varying by level.
research.locationNote: On Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, near the trunk’s established retail, park and monorail network. Confirm the actual unit orientation and access arrangements; the developer’s marketed panoramic views are not a substitute for its signed unit plan.
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists an original two-bedroom reference from AED 21m, while its FAQ gives AED 33m as a project starting price and marks developer stock out of stock. No current developer price list was retrieved, so a single numerical asking price is withheld. Resale advertising and transaction history do not confirm available primary inventory.
research.paymentNote: The branded original sheet shows 20% booking, six 10% payments from October 2023 to April 2026, then 20% on handover. All interim dates have passed at this review. This is historical evidence, not an offer that a new buyer can still select; obtain the unit’s current balance and contractual schedule.
research.handoverNote: Nakheel’s dated September 2024 construction-award announcement targets Q2 2028 handover. The earlier branded payment sheet says Q3 2027. The newer dated announcement is shown as the developer target, with both recorded; it remains an estimate requiring current contractual confirmation.

facts.label: Latest official progress reviewed
facts.value: Nakheel reports 23.02% overall progress from its 14 September 2026 internal inspection and separately cites 20.88% from a 6 July 2026 regulatory inspection. Different dates and inspection methods should not be treated as interchangeable.

facts.label: Published scope differs
facts.value: The current website describes 76 storeys and 76 residences; the September 2024 construction award describes 75 storeys and 81 residences. The older brochure refers to 71 floors. A current approved schedule is required to resolve these conflicting official descriptions.

facts.label: Parking examples
facts.value: The cited two-bedroom plan allocates three bays, the four-bedroom unit 1001 five, the six-bedroom unit 101 six, the seven-bedroom duplex 501 seven and the penthouse 6801 ten. Verify the actual sale agreement rather than extrapolating by bedroom count.

unresolved: No current developer unit quotation, inventory, service charges or updated payment calendar was retrieved.

Official floor/residence counts conflict; no unqualified total is displayed. The construction update lists IFG whereas the dated main contract award names ALEC; contractor scopes are not assumed equivalent.
The floor-plan set is conceptual and not a current contractual layout schedule. Some later table values and unit conversions conflict, so only individually inspected examples are used.

The old payment sheet’s 2027 handover must not override the later official 2028 announcement. No unverified portal regulatory completion date or progress percentage is presented as primary evidence. Images remain illustrative.
